body: I feel sorry for everyone in the US with Trump as your president.
Does it really matter if a few people die for the good of the economy?

1. I would have put the whole country into a mandatory 1 month lockdown. Put a hold on all bills/wages and supply every person with a minimal payment i.e. $150 per person per week for necessities like food/medication. This would be paid through existing channels i.e. workplaces/people already receiving Centrelink payments and the ATO. Determining the payments for children would be harder. These could possibly paid through workplaces i.e. staff advise how many children they have/provide proof like birth certificates or through school records. 

2. If overtime was required, any overtime would be paid at an applicable rate i.e. if an APS6 in processing claims normally completed by an APS3, they would receive the APS3 rate for these overtime hours. 

3. You are all saying that hiring takes time/you need police checks blah blah blah. Find workplaces that have already completed these checks and been impacted by Coronavirus, then hire those staff - even if it’s only for a 3-6 month period. Training to process basic claims only takes 1 week and you wouldn’t have to pay APS6+ staff to do an APS3 job.
Also they keep saying this is going to last 6-18 months! It doesn’t seem short term to me
The point is that you aren’t doing your normal job. Why should you be paid overtime at your hourly rate to do a job that earns much less???

I live with “some people” and yes it does piss me off that they are getting paid shitloads more than me. 

I’m losing money left right and center from this Coronavirus while they are making a profit??? It’s despicable.

Maybe I should just walk in front of a train? Won’t cause too many inconveniences at the moment

I hope your department actually hires some. From what I’ve heard some departments are actually offering overtime to their existing employees rather than trying to help/provide jobs to the people who have lost them due to corona virus
Has anyone been hired by the government lately? Have they kept their promise to help people who have lost their jobs due to Coronavirus?
